clue.text: Offer false inducements to have the roof covered

definitions.meaning: to string someone along or entice them deceptively
a roof sheeted with the metal is literally clad in ... top

explanation.surface: A builder is accused of luring customers with promises about roofing work.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom for deceiving with promises, and literally the grey metal laid over a roof.

clue.text: Register fewer items when apathetic

parts.note: a list is a register
less means a smaller quantity

explanation.surface: A shopper writes a shorter shopping list when feeling unmotivated.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking energy or enthusiasm, the same as being apathetic.

clue.text: A reservoir worker has to be resolute

parts.note: a dam holds back a reservoir of water
a worker is an ant, a classic crossword sense

explanation.surface: A waterworks employee must stand firm.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unyielding in one's decision.

clue.text: Exaggerate the president's position?

definitions.meaning: a head of state is placed over the state, read as a phrase

explanation.surface: A journalist wonders whether the president's stance is being hyped.
explanation.definitionFit: To overemphasise; whimsically, a president sits above the nation.

clue.text: Mysterious secret I revealed anew about love

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go round the letter for love, wrapping it
the letters of secret and I are laid out afresh in a new order

parts.note: love is zero in tennis scoring, the letter O

explanation.surface: A secret is disclosed once again, this time concerning a romance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revealed anew' rearranges SECRETI to ESTERIC, and 'about' puts that around O.
explanation.definitionFit: Esoteric knowledge is understood only by a small initiated circle, so it seems obscure and puzzling.

clue.text: It entitles many to become maudlin

definitions.note: adjective standing for a noun meaning excessive tender feeling

indicators.note: the letters of the three words are made to become something else

explanation.surface: A claim that some document qualifies lots of people to wallow in emotion.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessive tearful emotion is the quality of being maudlin.

clue.text: Trudge along quietly behind public vehicle

indicators.note: the letter for quietly comes behind the vehicle

parts.note: a tram is a public transport vehicle
P is piano, quietly in music

explanation.surface: Someone walks silently behind a bus or tram.
explanation.definitionFit: To tramp is to walk heavily or wearily.

clue.text: Criticised for being out of condition

explanation.surface: An athlete is criticised for being unfit.
explanation.definitionFit: To run down is to disparage; something run-down is tired or dilapidated.

clue.text: He phones to say he'll visit

definitions.meaning: one who makes a telephone call
a visitor who pays a call

explanation.surface: A man rings up to announce he is coming round.
explanation.definitionFit: One making a telephone call, or a visitor dropping in.

clue.text: Doing famously after leaving the artillery

parts.note: going means departing
great guns are heavy artillery pieces

explanation.surface: A soldier thrives once out of the gunners' regiment.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom for performing very successfully and vigorously.

clue.text: Plump up duvet to make the bed

parts.note: to shake a pillow or quilt is to fluff it up
a duvet is filled with feathers, i.e. down

explanation.surface: Housekeeping instructions: fluff up the quilt when tidying the bedroom.
explanation.walkthrough: A shakedown is a makeshift bed, and to shake down is to bed down somewhere improvised.
explanation.definitionFit: A shakedown is a temporary bed made up on the floor or sofa.

clue.text: Book of the year

parts.note: not a prize-winning novel but a chronicle recording the events of one single year

explanation.definitionFit: Historical record kept year by year, each entry covering twelve months.

clue.text: Military communication is a secret affair

definitions.meaning: contact and cooperation between units of armed forces

explanation.surface: Army signals turn out to be cover for clandestine romance.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both coordination between units and an illicit romantic entanglement.

clue.text: One representative learning to plead

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
an MP is a Member of Parliament, an elected representative in the UK
lore is traditional knowledge or learning

explanation.surface: A single elected official uses scholarship to make an appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: To beg earnestly is synonymous with pleading.

clue.text: Reflective art from America found in Hindu literature

indicators.note: reflection turns each word back, so both art and the abbreviation are read backwards

parts.note: taken as written
US is the United States of America

explanation.surface: Contemplative American art turns up within Hindu writings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reflective' turns ART to TRA and US to SU: SU then TRA.
explanation.definitionFit: A sutra is an aphorism or collection of them in Sanskrit scripture.

clue.text: Putting fat on made a singer take note

parts.note: G is a musical note

indicators.note: the letters of a singer are made into something new

explanation.surface: An overweight vocalist is told to pay attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made' rearranges A SINGER to REASING, after G.
explanation.definitionFit: Applying lard or oil to a pan or axle is lubricating it.

clue.text: A monosyllable is inevitably limited

definitions.meaning: a one-syllable word is necessarily a brief word

explanation.surface: A linguist notes that a one-syllable word must be restricted.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief word, literally; also lasting only a brief span of time.

clue.text: The man will catch criminal if totally determined

parts.note: he is the man
'll is the contracted form of will
bent is slang for corrupt or criminal

explanation.surface: A man resolves to catch a crook come what may.
explanation.walkthrough: BENT is British slang for crooked or corrupt.
explanation.definitionFit: Hell-bent means recklessly resolved on something.

clue.text: Place adhesive around a small window

indicators.note: the adhesive goes around the other letters, enclosing them

parts.note: cement is a binding adhesive
S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing sizes

explanation.surface: Instructions for fixing a little window frame with glue.
explanation.definitionFit: A casement is a window hinged at the side.

clue.text: Opposed to making a profit, by the way

parts.note: gain is profit
St, street, is a way

explanation.surface: Someone is incidentally hostile to profiteering.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in opposition or hostile to something.

clue.text: Fantastic tour arranged to the Orient

indicators.note: the word tour is arranged into a different order

parts.note: the Orient is the East, E

explanation.surface: A marvellous trip to the Far East has been booked.
explanation.definitionFit: Outre means bizarre or outlandish, beyond the bounds of convention.

clue.text: Taking rum-punch into work creates uproar

indicators.note: the mixed letters go into the word for work

parts.note: toil is hard work

indicators.note: rum is punched about, mixed like a punch drink

explanation.surface: Bringing rum punch to the office causes chaos.
explanation.walkthrough: 'punch' mixes RUM to URM, and 'into' puts it inside TOIL.
explanation.definitionFit: Turmoil means confusion and disorder.

clue.text: Withdraw when there's a shout in the distance

parts.note: to cry is to shout
off means away, distant

explanation.surface: Retreat when someone yells far away.
explanation.definitionFit: To cry off is to back out of an arrangement.

clue.text: Let in again and let out again

definitions.meaning: allow back in to a place
confess a second time, let out meaning reveal

explanation.surface: A doorman lets the same person in and out repeatedly.
explanation.definitionFit: Allowing back inside and confessing anew both fit, admit meaning both permit entry and acknowledge.

clue.text: Male said to be of virtuous nature

parts.note: oral means spoken

explanation.surface: A man is said to be of good character.
explanation.definitionFit: Moral means ethically good.

clue.text: Subsequently given a quid on the side

parts.note: later means afterwards
a quid is a pound sterling, abbreviated L (from Latin libra)

explanation.surface: Someone is later paid a pound as a backhander.
explanation.definitionFit: Lateral means relating to or situated at the flank.

clue.text: He acknowledges that he's the proprietor

definitions.meaning: one who owns up, admitting something

explanation.surface: A man admits that the business is his.
explanation.definitionFit: To own is both to admit and to possess, so this person admits or possesses.

clue.text: On the wrong track at the Arctic

definitions.meaning: British slang for mistaken or confused
literally high up at the North Pole

explanation.surface: An explorer has lost his way near the North Pole.
explanation.definitionFit: British idiom for being mistaken or muddled, and literally northward at the pole.

clue.text: Obese African leader confronts lean determinist

parts.note: obese means fat

indicators.note: the first letter of the word it picks from

parts.note: the leading letter of African is A
to list is to lean, as a ship does

explanation.surface: A portly African ruler squares up to a skinny philosopher.
explanation.definitionFit: A fatalist believes events are predetermined and inevitable.

clue.text: Charm a stubborn brute with time

parts.note: a mule is proverbially stubborn

explanation.surface: Patience might win over an obstinate beast.
explanation.definitionFit: An amulet is a talisman worn for protection.
